scripts.dev: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter web dev
scripts.build: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter functions build && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.test:integration: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-96order --only firestore,auth,storage "pnpm --filter web run test:integration"
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter web test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:auth: pnpm run build:shared && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-96order --only firestore,auth "pnpm --filter web run test:e2e:auth"
